title: Provider Details
shortDescription: Providers refers to an entity that can be a practitioner or facility. Details of the providers present in a Newtork are displayed in Provider Details page.
body:
The Provider Details can be accessed in the following modules: * Competitive Dashboard * Compare Networks * Create a List * Look Up a Group * Look Up a Provider * Model Networks * Recruitment When you click on a provider from the providers displayed in the **Detail Results** page or **Search Results** page or **Group Profile** page (depending on the module you are using), the **Provider Details** page will display. Each provider name is a link to open additional details about that provider. The provider’s ID, NPI and Client ID are in the top right corner of the provider profile page. The screenshot below is an example showing information about the selected Provider in the Provider Profile page.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/provider_details1.png)
Clicking on the Provider link in the Provider Details page displays Group Profile Page showing the Group details to which that provider belongs. For more information on Group Profile, see [Group Profile](/#!/help/sections/using-network360/sections/group-profile) help content.

Understanding Provider Details
The information about each provider is viewable within the following tabs: * Networks * Map * CMS * Comments * Attributes ### Networks Tab
Within the **Networks** tab on the Provider Details Page, the following details can be found: * Each location/address that the provider practices * The networks/plans that the provider accepts * Tags and Confidence indicators * Specialty at each location
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/provider_details2.png)
Addresses and specialties are accompanied by a color-coded icon representing the confidence score, which is a number between 0 and 1. For more details on the color code of **Confidence scores**, please refer the [Glossary](#!/help/sections/glossary?s=c&t=confidence-scores). Clicking on a location (under the Location column, shown in the screenshot above) will navigate you to the Group Profile page. ### Map Tab Within the **Map** tab on the Provider Details Page, the following details can be found: * Each location/address associated to the provider. * The number of other providers at that location, which is a link to open a pop-up box that will list each provider and their specialty(ies). The pop-up box contains a link to view a list that contains the details on each of these providers. * A map indicating each of the locations.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/3.png)
### CMS Tab Additional information from Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, if available, for that provider, will be displayed in CMS tab.
The CMS tab contains: An overview of information about the provider from the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Service. * Gender * Medical School * Graduation Year * Group Practice(s) * Hospital Affiliation(s) * Specialty(s)
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/4.png)
### Comments Tab The Comments tab contains: * Comments that you and other users of the system have added about the provider. * A button and link to add a comment.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/5.png)
### Attributes Tab The **Attributes** tab contains information about the practicing location for each provider. Attributes are custom to a client and can have a variety of topics. Please talk to your client success manager about adding or maintaining attributes.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/6.png)

Exporting Details List of Provider Profile
**Procedure for Exporting a Detailed Provider List** Click the **Export** button. In the modules like Look Up a Group, Look Up a Provider, Network360 will display a message to let you know that the export process has begun. Once the Export is ready to be downloaded an additional message will be displayed with a summary of your search criteria and a link to Download results. (or) 1. The Export dropdown provides options to export the Provider List. (**Note:** Export type options available in the Export dropdown are displayed as per the module selected like Compare Networks, Recruitment, Create a List. Example for options available in export dropdown: Concise Office List, Concise Provider List, Provider List Details, Export CSV, Export PDF etc.,)
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/exporting-provider-profile.png)
3. Select the columns you want to include in your export. Available columns: * **Networks** - When you choose Networks, you can select either summary or specialty details * **Tags** * **Provider Comments** and/or **Custom Attributes** (if applicable) 4. Click the **Export** button The Provider Details List is exported as a **.csv** file or **.pdf** file depending on selected option. **Selecting Networks for Exporting a Detailed Provider List** * When you select **Networks** with **Summary**, your export will include a Network column for each provider-location in the Detail Results and the specialty will be the best match from all the networks. * When you select **Networks** with **Specialty Details**, your export will include all provider-location-specialty combinations, rather than only the best match specialty.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/provider_details7.png)
**Note:** When you select **Networks** with either **Summary** or **Specialty Details**, Par Indicator (Participating Indicator) codes are included in the Network column(s) for each provider-location-specialty combination in the export file.
